body:
Combined MAINLINE-032/032b check filed. All 533 comparisons pass: 236 retained from the immutable 032 check and 297 new engineering numeric/Boolean scalar checks. Both owners’ artifact sets and the earlier check pins match. No owner code read or run.

Conditional 032 lead amplitudes reproduce: S-200F/SR-200 0.152868766846/0.065222906404 mm at 60 psi; 0.089173447327/0.038046695402 mm at 35 psi. Fc still means minimum compression/tension/bond strength; 35 psi is minimum average. Retain the lead-only amplitude/cell correction to 0.00684754923–0.01604921437.

ER-1001’s 0.000065-inch depth converts to 0.001651 mm. Figures 22/30 identify both relevant coupons as 0.008-inch faces. The 3/8-inch slopes remain slopes; derived depths are projections.

Correct Woody’s 3 micrometres to template-adjustment RMS, not finished-surface RMS. Its 24-micrometre estimate and von Hoerner’s historical 0.2032-mm vendor RMS reproduce but do not identify the wrinkle component.

Omitted evidence exists: Rion’s thin carbon/epoxy–Nomex experiments measure cell depths near that system’s critical wavelength, with an empirical shape conversion. Camarda also measures panel maxima, not critical-band amplitude. Neither establishes Be/CR-III waviness.

A conditional flat-panel calculation gives full wrinkle periods about 37–40 mm, near/below Woody’s stated measurement band. No matching Be/CR-III modal measurement was found in the documented search. Ten earlier findings and six new nonblocking records retained. QUESTIONABLE remains. No successor job.
